entries.category: Release Available: Client Connector 5.0.3 for iOS
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 5.0.3 Enhancements and Fixes
entries.text:
Fixes an issue that caused Private Access reauthentication to fail in the redesigned Zscaler Client Connector UI when the identity provider returned a NameID without a domain.
Fixes an issue that prevented users on Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later from accessing Wi-Fi, even when Internet & SaaS and Private Access showed as connected.

entries.title: Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management Support for Zoho
entries.text:
You can configure Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) for Zoho tenants. Select the SSPM Scan checkbox when onboarding a tenant to enable the Advanced SSPM scan capability for the specific tenant.
The SSPM Scan checkbox is available only when you have Advanced SSPM enabled for your tenant.
To learn more, see What Is Advanced Posture Management? and Adding SaaS Application Tenants.

entries.title: DLP and Malware Support for Claude
entries.text:
You can create DLP and Malware Scanning policies for Claude under the Gen AI category.
To onboard your Claude application, go to Data Security > DSPM > SaaS Application Tenants, then click Add and choose Claude as a tenant.
To create DLP policies, go to Data Security > DSPM > SaaS DLP > Gen AI and define the policy criteria for your Claude application.
To create Malware Scanning policies, go to Data Security > DSPM > Malware Scanning > Gen AI and define the policy criteria for your Claude application.
To learn more, see:
Understanding SaaS Security Supported Capabilities
Adding SaaS Application Tenants
Configuring the Data at Rest Scanning DLP Policy with Content Inspection
Configuring the Data at Rest Scanning Malware Detection Policy

entries.title: DLP Support for QR Code Dictionary
entries.text:
DLP supports the QR Code predefined dictionary, which detects images of QR codes in supported file types such as JPEG and PNG.
To learn more, see Understanding Predefined DLP Dictionaries.

entries.title: Expanded File Type Support for File Type Control & Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
entries.text:
The following predefined file types have been added to File Type Control and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for Inline, Endpoint, Outbound Email, and Data at Rest Scanning:
ABAP Behavior Definition Language (.abdl)
ABAP Core Data Services (CDS) (.acds)
ABAP Source Code (.abap)
ASP.NET Web Source (.asp, .aspx, .ascx, .asax)
Class Module File (.cls)
C++ Source (.cxx)
Electronic Business Card (.vcf)
Java Server Faces Script (.jsf)
Java Server Page (.jsp)
Java Server Pages Fragment (.jspf)
JVM Apache Groovy (.gsh, .groovy, .gvy)
Kotlin Script (.kts)
Kotlin Source (.kt)
PHP Source (.php)
R Statistical Script (.r)
TypeScript (.ts)
TypeScript+JSX (.tsx)
In addition to the common file types, the following file types are also supported in File Type Control and specific DLP policies:
File Type Control
DLP Rules without Content Inspection
DLP Rules with Content Inspection
To learn more, see Configuring the File Type Control Policy, Configuring DLP Policy Rules with Content Inspection, Configuring DLP Policy Rules without Content Inspection, Configuring Outbound Email Policy Rules, Configuring Endpoint DLP Policy Rules, and Configuring the Data at Rest Scanning DLP Policy with Content Inspection.

entries.title: Filter SaaS Security Insights Logs for Deleted Activity
entries.text:
The Is Deleted filter is added to SaaS Security Insights Logs to help filter transactions associated with the Delete activity.
To learn more, see Understanding the Assets Report: Assets with Incidents, About the Activities Report, and About SaaS Security Insights Logs.

entries.title: Metered API Labeling Support for Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint
entries.text:
You can override an existing lower priority MIP label to a higher priority MIP label or vice versa with the Metered APIs Labeling support.
To enable this, onboard your OneDrive and SharePoint tenants with the Metered APIs Labeling option.
Further, create policies with the action, Apply MIP Label (Metered API) to apply a new label or override an existing one to your Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, and PDF file types.
Tenants onboarded with Zscaler Defined connector can change their connector type to Custom and revalidate their tenant account to use this functionality.

entries.title: Support for New Predefined DLP Dictionaries
entries.text:
The following predefined Data Loss Prevention (DLP) dictionaries are supported for use in DLP policy rules:
Argentina National Identity Document (DNI)
Czech Republic Personal Identification Number
Kenya Passport Number
KRA Tax Registration PIN (Kenya)
Latvia Personal Identification Number
National Identification Number (Kenya)
Portugal Social Security Number (SSN)
Romanian Personal Identification Number
Tax Identification Number (Cyprus)
Telephone Number (Asia)
Venezuela Personal Identification Number
To learn more, see Understanding Predefined DLP Dictionaries.
